name: Screened Porch, New Jersey
lede: In a gut-renovated 1960s colonial, the new screened porch has become the family’s gathering place, all day long. Two black Tungsten Electric heaters, hung above the screens, keep it warm through a New Jersey winter.

hero.caption: Two black Tungsten Electric heaters on drop poles under the vaulted ceiling. Bromic-published photograph from the case study.

photos.caption: Bromic-published photograph from the case study.
Tungsten Electric under the timber ceiling. Bromic-published photograph from the case study.

beats: The first floor was gutted and reconfigured, adding a screened porch with a lounge and a dining area. A traditional fireplace adds ambience but is not the heat source.
The porch had to stay warm through cold winters and hot summers. The heaters had to sit above the metal screens yet direct heat downward, without overheating the space.

The first plan called for three heaters on three walls. Bromic’s specialists advised that three would be too much heat for the square footage, so two black Tungsten Electric 4000 W heaters hang on ceiling-mounted suspension poles above the screens, facing down.
